info.title: tgvault API
info.description: Encrypted object storage on Telegram. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer tgv_<id>_<secret>`. Every request is rate limited per key; public routes are limited per IP. Errors share one shape: `{"error": {"code", "message"}}`.

post.description: Exchanges the admin password for an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict session cookie. Send the returned `csrf` value as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request made with the cookie. Limited to 10 attempts per minute per IP.

get.description: Returns the caller's actor id, scopes and bucket restriction. Works with API keys too.

Buckets the caller may see, with object counts and bytes (live + trash).

**Scope:** `list`

post.description:
Bucket names are 3-63 characters of `a-z`, `0-9` and `-`.

**Scope:** `admin`

get.description:
Settings and current usage.

patch.description:
Send only the fields to change. `quota_bytes: 0` and `default_ttl: 0` remove the limit.

delete.description:
Refuses while the bucket holds objects unless `force=true`, which deletes every object (including trash) and its chunks.

**Scope:** `admin`

get.description:
Lists live objects in key order. With `delimiter=/`, keys below the next `/` are folded into `common_prefixes` (folders). Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

**Scope:** `list`

put.description:
Streams the raw request body into encrypted chunks; nothing is buffered beyond one chunk per upload slot. An existing object at the key moves to the trash (previous version). Optional headers: `Content-Type`, `X-TGV-TTL` (seconds until automatic deletion), `X-TGV-Meta-<name>` (user metadata, 2 KB total), `If-None-Match: *` (fail if the key exists). Single uploads are limited by `TGV_MAX_UPLOAD_GIB`; use multipart for very large files or flaky links.

**Scope:** `write`

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Object key; may contain `/`. Percent-encode each segment.

get.description:
Returns the bytes, decrypting only the 64 KiB blocks a request touches. Supports `Range` (206 Partial Content, used by video players to seek), `If-None-Match` (304) and `If-Range`. `?download=1` forces a save dialog. HTML, SVG, XML and script types are always sent as attachments with a sandbox CSP.

**Scope:** `read`

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Object key; may contain `/`. Percent-encode each segment.

head.description:
Same headers as GET without the body: size, type, ETag.

**Scope:** `read`

parameters.name: key

delete.description:
Moves the object to the trash. `permanent=true` deletes it at once; its chunks are removed from Telegram by the next clean-up when no other object shares them.

**Scope:** `delete`

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Object key; may contain `/`. Percent-encode each segment.

post.description:
Server-side copy that shares the encrypted chunks (no re-upload). Needs `read` on the source bucket and `write` on this one.

**Scope:** `read + write`

If this bucket already stores bytes with the given SHA-256, creates `key` pointing at them without sending the data. Returns 404 when there is no match, in which case upload normally. Matching is limited to the same bucket so a hash alone cannot unlock someone else's file.

**Scope:** `write`

post.summary: Import a file from a URL
post.description:
The server downloads `url` itself and streams it, encrypted, straight into the bucket: nothing is written to disk and your client does not relay the bytes. Returns 202 with a job to poll, or with `wait: true` blocks and returns the object (201). Only public http/https addresses are fetched: loopback, private, link-local (cloud metadata), CGNAT and other reserved ranges are refused, including after DNS resolution and on every redirect (max 5). `headers` are sent to the source (for example `Referer` or `Authorization`); `Host` and hop-by-hop headers are not allowed. Size limits and bucket quota apply while streaming.

**Scope:** `write`

parameters.name: X-TGV-TTL
parameters.description: Seconds until the imported object expires

key.description: Defaults to the last URL path segment

get.description:
State is `queued`, `downloading`, `storing`, `done` or `failed`. Jobs are kept for 24 hours after they finish.

**Scope:** `write`

Imports started by the caller (admins see all).

**Scope:** `write`

post.description:
Returns an `upload_id`. Then PUT parts numbered from 1, in any order and in parallel; re-sending a part replaces it. Uploads not completed within 24 hours are aborted.

**Scope:** `write`

get.description:
Uploads started by the caller (admins see all).

**Scope:** `write`

put.description:
Raw body. Parts can be any size; each is split into chunks server-side.

**Scope:** `write`

post.description:
Joins parts 1..N in order. Fails if a part number is missing. Accepts the same `X-TGV-TTL` and `X-TGV-Meta-*` headers as a single PUT.

**Scope:** `write`

Returns a URL anyone can use until it expires (max 7 days), like an R2 presigned URL. GET links stream with Range support, so they work as `<video src>` on any site listed in the bucket's CORS origins. PUT links let a browser upload directly; set `content_type` to pin the upload's type. Revoking or down-scoping the signing key invalidates its links.

**Scope:** `read (GET) / write (PUT)`

bearer.description: API key created in the panel or via POST /api/v1/keys

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed; the message says which field.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks a scope, bucket or IP permission, or the CSRF token is missing.

NotFound.description: Not found, or not visible to this key.

Conflict.description: The resource already exists or is in use.

default_ttl.description: Seconds; new objects expire after this
